2609.27395.title: PRISM-VLM: A Multi-Axis Discriminative Benchmark for Compact Vision-Language Models
2609.27395.paper_summary: Compact vision-language models (VLMs) now power a growing share of multimodal applications. The benchmarks used to compare them, however, inherit a frontier-centric design: each model is reduced to a single accuracy number, narrowing the inter-model gap on saturated suites and pressing models into low-score bands on harder ones. We introduce PRISM-VLM, a multi-axis discriminative benchmark that scores every item along seven axes covering the recurring failure modes (task quality, behavioral robustness, and capability bottlenecks) and combines them into a single PScore, with items recycled from fifteen public benchmarks. Across compact VLMs from the past two years, PScore separates model pairs more reliably than prior single-axis benchmarks under an item-level paired bootstrap, and surfaces behavioral differences these benchmarks average away. Even models with statistically indistinguishable PScores diverge sharply along the per-axis profile, particularly on sycophancy, which is nearly orthogonal to single-prompt accuracy. We will release the full pipeline, prompts, and per-item annotations.
2609.27395.paper_summary_zh: 緊湊的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）現在驅動著越來越多的多模態應用。然而，用於比較它們的基準測試卻繼承了一種以邊界為中心的設計：每個模型被簡化為一個單一的準確性數字，這使得在飽和的測試套件中縮小了模型之間的差距，並將模型壓入更低的分數範圍，尤其是在更困難的測試中。我們介紹了PRISM-VLM，一個多軸的區分基準，該基準沿著七個軸對每個項目進行評分，涵蓋了重複出現的失敗模式（任務質量、行為穩健性和能力瓶頸），並將它們組合成一個單一的PScore，這些項目來自十五個公共基準。在過去兩年的緊湊VLM中，PScore在項目級配對自助抽樣下比以往的單軸基準更可靠地區分模型對，並揭示了這些基準平均掉的行為差異。即使是統計上無法區分的PScores，在每個軸的輪廓上也會有明顯的差異，特別是在諂媚行為上，這幾乎與單一提示的準確性正交。我們將發布完整的管道、提示和每個項目的註釋。
2609.27395.author: Sanghee Park et.al.
